therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: sunitinib malate plus irradiated donor lymphocytes
therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: VEGFR/PDGFR kinases plus allogeneic immune activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: multi-kinase inhibition combined with adoptive immunotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor angiogenesis inhibition plus enhanced anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic kidney cancer with partially HLA-matched family donors

results.dose_information: sunitinib 50 mg daily for 4 weeks followed by 2 weeks off per cycle; irradiated donor lymphocytes approximately every 8 weeks
